analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($92.36) vs SMA5 ($95.37)/SMA20 ($96.48)/SMA50 ($92.65): Below short-term and mid-term SMAs, testing resistance zone.
· Above SMA100 ($92.00)/SMA200 ($82.31): Mid-to-long-term trend remains intact.
· 52-Week Position (79.4%) + Current price is approximately 9% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (58.0→43.2): Entering oversold territory, indicating strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.3565→-0.7726): Worsening trend, bearish momentum expanding after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Lower Band $91.55): Approaching the lower band, with a band width of 10.22% indicating increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($88.30): Based on the 0.618 Fibonacci retracement level.
· Swing Resistance ($93.69): Near the previous low and the pivot point (PP).
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($89.16) not higher than 20-day low ($89.16), 5-day high ($98.86) not lower than 20-day high ($101.62): Sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.42x): Increased volume accompanying recent moves, suggesting higher conviction.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Accumulation phase; while leaning towards a buy, further downside is possible due to RSI oversold and MACD worsening, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
